title: Nasruddin Tale 183: The Stolen Blanket
summary: Hearing a violent brawl in the street late at night, Nasruddin wrapped his warm woolen blanket around his shoulders and ran out to make peace....
full_text:
Hearing a violent brawl in the street late at night, Nasruddin wrapped his warm woolen blanket around his shoulders and ran out to make peace.

As soon as he stepped into the crowd, a rogue snatched the blanket off his back and ran away, and the other brawlers immediately dispersed!

Nasruddin walked back into his cold bedroom shivering.

"What was the quarrel about, husband?" asked his wife.

"It was about my blanket!" sighed Nasruddin. "As soon as they got it, the dispute ended completely!"
moral: Do not meddle in street brawls unless you are willing to lose your own blanket.
